news.title: Update 1.6 - 20 new cosmetics, sold one by one
news.text: 20 new cosmetics, sold one by one, and faster cosmetics sync. Click for the full changelog.

list.s: 5 capes, 5 pairs of wings, 5 bands and 5 pets you can buy one by one, 3.49 each. No need to buy a whole bundle.
Pixel art capes, wings in many colours with a realistic flap and cute pixel pets.
The store now shows 3 products per row on your phone.
When a player changes cosmetics, the others see it in about 2 seconds instead of 8.
Wings, capes and pets are built once and reused, so crowded servers run smoother.
Store, site and launcher show every cosmetic full body on your own skin, all framed the same way.
The YA logo next to a name stays aligned, also in front view and when spectating.

news.title: Update 1.5 - 90+ mods for every mode, and the first YA Plus tools
news.text: 90+ mods for every mode, and the first YA Plus tools. Click for the full changelog.

list.s: SMP: Nether Coords, Death Location, Day Counter, Light Level, Distance Walked, Elytra Info, Breath, XP Progress. Crystal PvP: Crystals Nearby, Obsidian, Anchor and Totem counters, Offhand Item, Totem Warning. BedWars and SkyWars: Blocks Left, Resources, BedWars Items, Buckets, Look Angles. SkyBlock: Free Slots, Mob Counter, Dropped Items, XP Bottles.
YA Trail, Hit Sparks, Rainbow HUD, Fall Alert and Session Stats. They carry a gold PLUS badge in the menu.
FOV slider plus Toggle Sneak, No Auto Jump, Unlimited FPS, VSync Off, No FOV Effects, No Screen Effects and No Bobbing.
Built in, always on: the wheel moves one slot at a time, and the hotbar does not change while you eat, draw a bow or block.
One dark label with the YA logo, the name and the gold + for Plus members, identical to the 1.21 versions.
The YA crosshair sits exactly in the middle and replaces the vanilla one, so you never see two.
Also lowers ambient occlusion, render distance and simulation distance, and gives everything back when you turn it off.
HUD text is computed 10 times a second instead of several times per frame, and lookups are cached.
Wings and capes are lit evenly, no more dark wing on one side.
Texts on capes, like the Qlux one, now read the right way round.
You can now scroll down to the last row of bundles.
The name with the YA logo shows above your head in third person.

news.title: Update 1.4 - Now on 1.21.x, with a brand new launcher
news.text: Now on 1.21.x, with a brand new launcher. Click for the full changelog.

list.s: Mod menu, HUD, cosmetics and name tags on Minecraft 1.21.1, 1.21.4, 1.21.8 and 1.21.11, next to 26.2 and 1.8.9.
Bundles, Cloaks, Wings, Bandanas, Pets and Partner with real previews and a loadout strip. Equip a whole bundle in one click.
Pick 1.8.9, 1.7, 1.16, 1.21 or 26.x from illustrated cards. YA CLIENT versions are marked with a star.
RAM, Java, language and launch options in one clean window, plus a background switcher next to Launch.
The top bar shows the face of the signed in player and asks you to sign in when you are not. Offline accounts can play, cosmetics are for premium accounts.
YA Plus members get a soft red glow in the launcher sidebar.
Choose Vanilla, Fabric or Fabric + Sodium for every supported version.
The list shows 1.8.9, 1.7, 1.16, 1.21 and 26.x instead of every old snapshot.
Rounded corners, scrolling and clipping work on every version.
The normal cape is hidden while a YA cape is equipped.

news.title: Update 1.3 - The new client for Minecraft 26.2
news.text: The new client for Minecraft 26.2. Click for the full changelog.

list.s: New Fabric client for the latest Minecraft with a mod menu on Right Shift and a draggable, resizable HUD.
Supplies counter (crystals, obsidian, totems, gapples), Target HUD and totem pops, plus FPS, CPS, Keystrokes, armor, potions, ping and more.
Chat (no background, resizable), No Clouds, Block Outline with custom colors and Smooth Shift.
FPS Boost is on by default with better JVM settings, so you get a lot more frames.
Zoom with the mouse wheel as much as you want and a gentler motion blur.
The mod menu and the chat open much faster.
WASD and jump no longer get stuck or press on their own.
Sword swing on the ground and block animation now work like on 1.7.
Automatic Java 25 for the new versions and a more reliable updater.

news.title: Update 1.2 - Friends and a new look
news.text: Friends and a new look. Click for the full changelog.

list.s: Add friends by Minecraft name from the launcher or in game, accept requests and see who is online. Online friends sit at the top of the list with a green dot.
A card appears in the top right corner with the YA logo, the name and a green dot when a friend comes online.
The title screen now has a full quality photo background with slow motion, water shimmer and a pulsing sun glow.
Light grey look, 3D skin of the logged in player, YA Plus welcome and setup, and a red theme for YA Plus members.
The launcher downloads Java 8, 17 or 21 by itself. Nothing to install.

list.b: New store and YA Plus page
list.s: Real 3D cosmetics on a mannequin, prices and a dedicated YA Plus page.
Smaller buttons, icons only in the dock, centered hub with a friends button.
The YA logo now sits in front of the name of every YA CLIENT player.
The panorama is no longer tilted.
More reliable downloads during releases.

news.title: Update 1.1 - 14 new mods, dragon wings and many fixes
news.text: 14 new mods, dragon wings and many fixes. Click for the full changelog.

list.s: Combo, Bow Charge, Block Info, No Hurt Cam, Background FPS, Low Health, Target HUD, Item Counter, Inventory HUD, Nearby Players, Hit Color, AutoGG, Minimap and 1.7 Animations.
Black 3D dragon wings with a smooth, continuous flap animation, plus a fully black cape with the white infinity logo.

list.b: Client logo in the tab list
list.s: Players using YA CLIENT show the real logo next to their name.
Every update is listed in the client with all details.
Main menu, hub and mod menus are more compact and scale properly on any screen.
Tags no longer cover the preview and wings stay inside the card.
Wings keep flapping while you walk, jump or fall instead of resetting.
The launcher can update itself from GitHub releases.
Entity hitboxes are re-applied every frame so they stay on.
Sword block-hit swing and lower sword position now work.
Removed the placeholder letters in the tab list in favour of the logo.
